title: Test selection for the TDD inner loop (groups + affected map)

slices.description: run.sh gains @group tags, group args, --list; no-args path byte-identical.
steps: Baseline pinned: full-suite stdout/stderr captured pre-edit under .harness-mini/trace/runtime/0063-baseline/; no-args run after the change is byte-identical with summary Passed: 975 Failed: 0 and exit 0.
--list prints every @group name with static assert counts; union of groups partitions the file (sum of per-group assert counts == 975; no orphan executable lines between groups except header/footer).
run.sh <known-group> runs only that group (assert count matches --list); unknown group prints usage and exits non-zero; per-group wall time recorded, largest <= 60s.

slices.description: tests/groups.tsv impact map + tests/affected.sh deterministic selector.
steps: affected.sh with a known changed path (e.g. bin/harness.sh cmd_update region) prints the expected group name; with an unknown path prints all; with empty diff prints nothing and exits 0.
Self-test proves every group in groups.tsv exists as an @group tag in run.sh and vice versa.
groups.tsv and affected.sh are pure POSIX/bash with no third-party deps.

slices.description: SKILL + docs lines: narrow inner loop, full-suite gates.
steps: skills/tdd/SKILL.md gains the narrow-run rule (narrowest group for red-green; full suite for gates).
skills/checkpoint/SKILL.md and skills/evaluate/SKILL.md each gain one line reaffirming gates run the full suite.
README (or docs walkthrough) gains a short 'Running tests' note covering run.sh [group...] | --list and tests/affected.sh.
